notes: The selector enumerates the exact two qualifying deployment/rollout-completion messages (the shipped-feature message in T01WORKSPACE and the v3-pipeline-complete message in T02NORTHSTAR) as the finite mechanical witness for the semantic category 'deployment- or rollout-completion message'; this is a construction witness matching the design's two intended matches, not a live keyword search, since the underlying judgment ('is this a deployment/rollout completion') is a human/semantic one already fixed by the design roles. T03GHOSTORG is excluded because no user_teams row ties any user to it, even though it owns C_GHOST and hosts a check-reacted rollout-completion message from U_INCOGNITO, who is only a conversation member there (not a workspace member) — this is the negative_referent guarding against the channel-team-association shortcut. T01WORKSPACE's wrong_reaction_lukas message keeps its pre-existing 'eyes' reaction (unchanged, since it doesn't affect the workspace's qualification via the other message) and T02NORTHSTAR's ns_member_no_reaction message has no reaction, per design. Actor U01AGENBOT9 was given user_teams membership in T02NORTHSTAR and channel membership in both C_NORTHSTAR_ENG and C_GHOST so that conversations.history/users.list calls can genuinely discover the second workspace's members/messages and the ghost workspace's channel/team_id (establishing the negative) through documented APIs, consistent with the multiworkspace access qualification; no teams.list API exists, so workspace discovery for the report relies on these membership-based anchors plus visibility of team_id via conversations.info on known channels.
